name: Plaxi The Monarch
bio: From a chrysalis deep in the Wanewood, Plaxi the Monarch sprang forth. Risen from her eons-long slumber by Malice's machinations, she quickly departed the Emerald Kingdom to help soothe the world's wounds. A chorus of wingbeats herald her arrival, along with the gentle glow of a thousand glimmerwing butterflies.

effects.label: ATK Up
effects.description: Increases the recipient's Attack stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Skill Recovery Up
effects.description: Increases the recipient's Skill Recovery stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Shield
effects.description: Gives the recipient a HP Shield. All damage the recipient takes will be subtracted from the Shield first, before their HP.Each Skill can only cast one Shield at a time on each recipient.
